reason: Expert provides a successful fix for a base station cell failing to come up after a power outage on older units.

knowledge.summary: On older base stations, a standard reboot fails to bring up a cell after a power outage; perform a cold restart of the baseband unit by turning off power completely, waiting 30 seconds, and powering back on.
knowledge.author: Sanna Siirto
knowledge.details: Wait 30 seconds with power completely off before turning back on.
